## Appearing in "The Sins of the Fathers"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [⏴](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Avengers_Vol_1_191 "Avengers Vol 1 191")[Captain America (Steve Rogers)](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Steven_Rogers_(Earth-616) "Steven Rogers (Earth-616)")[⏵](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Captain_America_Vol_1_247 "Captain America Vol 1 247")

## Synopsis for "The Sins of the Fathers"

The story opens with school superintendent, Martin Harris, being pursued by a costumed Joe Smith, who badly beats him. [Captain America](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Steven_Rogers_(Earth-616) "Steven Rogers (Earth-616)") later encounters Joe tearing up a high rise Federal Building. The two fight but Cap is unable to capture him. Joe destroys a Social Security machine and escapes.

Steve Rogers' neighbor, Josh Cooper, is able to tell Steve about Joe's situation. Joe's son, Joey, was a special needs child who had recently died. Joe seems to blame the School Superintendent (for slashing funding), the Social Security System, and Larry Sawyer, a social worker who worked with his son Joey. Steve shadows Sawyer, Joe's last potential victim. Joe attacks Larry on the subway. Steve changes into uniform and again confronts Joe. This time Cap tells Joe that he knows his situation, but killing people is not the answer. Joe eventually breaks down and stops his pursuit of vengeance.

## Notes

*   [Joe Smith](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Joseph_Smith_(Earth-616) "Joseph Smith (Earth-616)") was first and last seen in [Amazing Spider-Man #38](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Amazing_Spider-Man_Vol_1_38 "Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 38").

*   The names of various comic creators are seen as graphitti on the subway train on this cover.

*   This issue contains a letters page, **"Letters to the Living Legend"**. Letters are published by _Matt Kaufman_ with a lengthy reply by [Roger Stern](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Roger_Stern "Roger Stern").

*   As seen on page one, this issue is Story#**LF-94**.

*   [Roger Stern](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Roger_Stern "Roger Stern") will become this series regular writer beginning next issue. [John Byrne](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/John_Byrne "John Byrne") will be the series artist.

Cover Date: June, 1980
Release Date: 1980
Release Date: March, 1980
